definitions: A village and municipality in the Semily District in the Liberec Region of the Czech Republic.
A village and part of the municipality of Nová Ves nad Popelkou in the Semily District in the Liberec Region of the Czech Republic.
A village and part of the municipality of Lipník nad Bečvou in the Přerov District in the Olomouc Region of the Czech Republic.
examples: Loučky is located in the Liberec Region.
The population of Loučky is small.
